It is well suited that this kayak, wilderness, outdoor company be named Talaysay because to have known Elder Theresa Jeffries and to know young Talaysay Campo, is to know that they are two of the same exceptionally fun, giving and adventurous people, which are the inspirations of this First Nations company striving to provide authentic cultural and eco experience.
